title: Helmeted Man in Velvet Suit
description: A person stands in the center of an elegant ballroom wearing a full-face black helmet with a glowing blue visor. They are dressed in a dark burgundy velvet suit with a matching harness across the chest, black gloves, and shiny black shoes.
prompt: A mysterious figure stands in a luxurious classical ballroom with chandeliers, wearing a sleek black full-face helmet with a glowing rectangular blue visor. The person is dressed in a rich dark burgundy velvet suit with leather harness straps across the chest, black gloves, and polished black shoes. Elegant guests in formal wear are visible blurred in the background. Dramatic lighting, upscale atmosphere, cinematic composition.
